notes.title: Demo update: fewer bugs, better performance and faster loading times.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have released a small update for the Junkienator demo, based on some of your initial feedback and internal optimisations. Many thanks to everyone who tried it!

Here are the main changes you'll find in this new version:

Performance improvements: We've worked to resolve some scene loading issues and make the game lighter on all platforms. Loading and performance should now be better on all platforms.
 
Gamepad fix: We fixed a bug that didn't show the on-screen buttons correctly when using a controller, especially during the burial puzzle.

Graphics fix: We have fixed a minor colour correction issue that could occur in the last level.

Please download the latest version of the demo to try out these improvements. Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please let us know what you think.

Thank you again for your support!
